primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Percentage of patients who achieved at least a 50% decrease from baseline in the total combined Erythema and Scaling score of all treated lesions at Week 4. A decrease is an improvement in measurement of erythema and scaling of the lesions.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: Per-protocol population all patients who had no major protocol deviations and were present at all scheduled visits up to and including Week 4.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Decrease in the Total Combined Erythema and Scaling Score (Minimum of 0 and Maximum of 65) of All Treated Lesions.
